messages:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — auditors want an evidence package for admin entitlements + KMS key access for Q4. They asked for who has admin roles, recent sign-ins, and KMS decrypt/iam events :eyes:
Raj: I can run the role-scan and pull the KMS audit stream. Will use the nightly export and filter by admin-role tags. Planning to run now, ETA ~30m.
Emma: FYI we need the exported CSV to include justification fields (owner, last used, ticket ref) so compliance can attach evidence. Also prefer separate staging/prod sets.
Raj: copying commands here for traceability:
```
./tooling/role_scan.sh --roles "org-admin,project-admin" --since 2025-12-01 --out /tmp/admin_evidence.csv
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt' --limit 10000 --project redwood-prod > /tmp/kms_decrypt_events.json
```
Raj: uploaded preliminary scans to https://logs.redwood.internal/teams/sec/1719005555/admin_evidence.tar.gz :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Automated check: role-scan completed, found 42 principals with admin-tag. 5 principals have no owner tag — flagged.
Matt: I see 3 of those no-owner principals are service accounts used by older CI jobs. I'll triage and add owners or rotate.
Olivia: Can we also capture KMS key policy snapshots for the keys that show decrypt events? Need the policy at time of event.
Raj: Yes — exported policies for keys referenced in kms_decrypt_events.json and included them in the tarball under /policies/.
Emma: Good. Two action items for the access review doc: (1) owners assigned for orphans, (2) rotate any service-account keys with >180 days age. I'll compile and send to auditors.
Olivia: Thanks — please ping when the final package is ready. Also, can someone run a quick least-priv check for the top 10 noisy principals (by decrypt count)? We want to see if any can be downgraded.
Raj: On it. Running a quick RBAC differential to compare current roles vs least-required heuristics. Will paste results in thread when done.
Matt: If you need me to quarantine any problematic keys or flip policies, lmk — I can schedule short maintenance window.
Raj: Differential done: 10 noisy principals -> 6 can be scoped to key-specific roles instead of project-admin. Adding recommended role changes to /tmp/role_redux_recs.csv and marking each with risk and rollout steps.
Olivia: Perfect. Emma, once you have the compiled evidence + recommendations we can schedule the entitlement cleanup sprint next week.
Emma: I'll assemble the package and post to the compliance workspace by EOD. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
